title: Main menu of an RTS I have been working on for a month
author: Unboxed_RTS
selftext: Alpha version also available to play online: [https://unboxed-alpha.vaneverdingen.dev/](https://unboxed-alpha.vaneverdingen.dev/)

comments.author: Morpegom
comments.body: Had to look at the sub when I saw the enumered main screen buttons. I hope that your in-game market (if theres any) doesnt have a "You can only buy in market if you have money" kind of text as well.

replies.author: Unboxed_RTS
replies.body: Wait can you elaborate? The game is free from start, I just added the numbers cause Claude Design came up with that. I see the pattern a lot in games nowadays so I thought it was justified. But if it brings the wrong associations I should definitely get rid of the numbers.

replies.author: Morpegom
replies.body:
You just said what associations it cames up with.

>cause Claude Design

Why does your game have enumered main title buttons if clicking a number does nothing (as far as I tested)? This is a very, very AI thing to do.

What I said about market design wasnt about real-money market, it was just an example that when AI takes over your design it likes to fill empty space with anything. From bloatware text or random slops.

replies.author: Unboxed_RTS
replies.body:
Aah yeah should definitely add proper shortcuts for navigating the menu yeah, probably with numbers as defaults.

Aah I see what you mean though, the current tooltips for UI related stuff are indeed very repetitive right now, but it's something that will be changed. It's just that some of the abilities themselves will change over time so it makes no sense to tune all of them right now. Though I think all of them have a description right now good enough for an alpha test.

comments.author: GayoMagno
comments.body: Any plans to release on mobile?

replies.author: Unboxed_RTS
replies.body:
Yes, but in my opinion mobile has a disadvantage vs PC. For instance, PC has left mouse button and right mouse button, for mobile this is an extra click (need to select some kind of "marker" first to state your intention: a move command, attack command, selection etc.). So ranked will be separated between PC and mobile, cross-play only possible with custom non-ranked lobbies. 

I do anticipate more mobile users than PC users eventually though, but fortunately I can port it easily to a mobile app, since it's all browser based.

replies.author: GayoMagno
replies.body:
Why not use a system similar to Old School Runescape?

You can use long press as the right click and define a certain amount of time that needs to be registered for the tap to be considered as right click (I use 100ms for OSRS and it feels super intuitive).

replies.author: Unboxed_RTS
replies.body:
Yes that might work for mobile, but I can't change that for PC players cause then the responsiveness is just slower, only to facilitate mobile.

But yeah it's definitely possible to allow this for mobile, maybe it needs to be some kind of setting. I do think for PC players it is already figured out though, so I stick to the controls and responsiveness from SC2 and other RTS games. 

Thank you for the suggestion though, since I played a lot of RuneScape myself, but forgot about this kind of interaction. I even played RuneScape a lot of mobile so I agree that this should also be a possibility.
